profile.headline: Software Engineer at ATX Networks Corp.
profile.summary:
I'm a software engineer who's been working in the telecommunications industry. I love challenges and love being able to use software to enhance our daily life.  I am skilled in C++ and Java. I am a very hard working person and have quick learning aptitude.
I have been working for ATX Networks (formerly Pico Digital) where I am contributing to the maintenance of our current products  to a more stable state as well as the enhancement of new features and development of more market-competitive products.
